# @aponiajs/platform-elysia

> The Elysia adapter that bootstraps an AponiaJS module graph into a running Bun HTTP and WebSocket server.

Decorated modules, controllers, gateways, and `@Validation()` models are the normal authoring surface here; direct validators, `elysiaController`, `defineElysiaController`, and `defineElysiaWebSocketGateway` stay available as escape hatches, and native Elysia plugins mount unchanged. Install it with `bun add @aponiajs/common @aponiajs/platform-elysia elysia`; `elysia` is a peer dependency.

## What this package exports

- [AponiaFactory](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/application/aponia-factory.ts): `create()` bootstraps an application, `createNative()` returns the exact composed Elysia instance for native tooling and Eden Treaty.
- [AponiaElysiaApplication](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/application/aponia-elysia-application.ts): the application wrapper with `handle`, `listen`, `get`, and `close`.
- [compileRootModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/modules/module-compiler.ts): lowers decorator metadata into the frozen descriptors `@aponiajs/core` consumes.
- [defineElysiaController, elysiaController, ELYSIA_CONTROLLER](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/controllers/controller-definition.ts): descriptor-first controller definitions and the concise native-registration facade.
- [HttpError, httpError, httpErrors](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/errors/http-error.ts): deliberate application failures serialized as RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
- [ElysiaPluginModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/plugins/plugin-module.ts): `register()` and `registerAsync()` mount a native Elysia plugin as a module import.
- [defineElysiaPlugin](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/plugins/plugin-module.ts): the same registration that also carries the plugin type, reachable as `plugin` at runtime.
- [defineElysiaWebSocketGateway](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/websockets/gateway-definition.ts): declares a gateway's path, message handlers, and server properties as data instead of through `@WebSocketGateway()` and `@SubscribeMessage()`.
- [downloadFile](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/routing/download-file.ts): writes the `content-disposition` value that names a download and returns the file the platform streams.
- [provideConfiguration](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/configuration/provider.ts): turns a declared configuration into the singleton provider that validates it once at boot.

## Public types

- [ElysiaRouteContext, ElysiaInputSchema](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/routing/route-context.types.ts): types a handler's context, taking a route schema, one plugin, or a tuple of plugins.
- [ElysiaPluginSource, ElysiaPluginTypes, ElysiaSet, ElysiaStatus, ElysiaStore](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/routing/route-context.types.ts): the native Elysia context fields named individually.
- [AponiaApplicationOptions, ConfiguredAponiaApplicationOptions, ElysiaCompilationOptions, NativeElysiaConfigurator](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/application/application.types.ts): bootstrap options, including the Elysia AOT and precompile policy.
- [AponiaNativeApplication](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/application/native-application.types.ts): the native application type the factory composes.
- [AponiaRootModule](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/modules/module-compiler.types.ts): what `compileRootModule` accepts.
- [ElysiaControllerDefinition, ElysiaControllerRegistrationOptions, ElysiaControllerRegistrationResult, RegisteredElysiaControllerDefinition, RegisteredElysiaApplication](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/controllers/controller.types.ts): controller definition and registration contracts.
- [HttpErrorStatus, HttpErrorStatusCode, HttpErrorStatusName, HttpErrorFactory, HttpErrorOptions, HttpErrorFactories, ProblemDetails, ResolveHttpErrorStatus](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/errors/http-error.types.ts): the typed error status surface.
- [ElysiaPluginImport, ElysiaPluginModuleOptions, AsyncElysiaPluginModuleOptions, NativeElysiaPlugin](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/plugins/plugin.types.ts): plugin registration contracts.
- [ElysiaWebSocket, ElysiaWebSocketServer](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/websockets/websocket-gateway.types.ts): transparent aliases over the native Elysia socket and server objects.
- [ElysiaWebSocketGatewayPlan, ElysiaWebSocketGatewayOptions, ElysiaWebSocketHandlerPlan, DeclaredElysiaWebSocketGateway](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/websockets/gateway-plan.types.ts): the declared gateway's plan, its option contract, and the provider it compiles to.
- [DownloadFileOptions](https://github.com/aponiajs/aponiajs/blob/release/alpha/packages/platform-elysia/src/routing/download-file.types.ts): `attachment` or `inline`, the disposition a download is named with.
